svg.title: One Accountable Owner, Three Contract Specialists
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: One Accountable Owner, Three Contract Specialists; subtitle: The four-person Base pod expands to six people only in the Scaled case.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time and C means contractor; contractor seats are people, not assumed full-time equivalents. Numeric values show Base seat occupancy: one for each active seat and zero for each Scaled-only addition. Sponsor personnel remain outside the pod.; caption: Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 4 C. Automation supports accountable operators rather than removing ownership.; stages: label: Owner and sponsor lead; value: Base seat: one full-time principal; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own pricing authority, sponsor relationships, placement contracts, cash controls, attrition review, and the annual owner-profit reconciliation; resolve exceptions raised by contractors.; label: Merchant acquisition specialist; value: Base seat: one sales contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain qualified cohorts, collect authorized statements, prepare accurate proposals, and negotiate venue introductions without promising sponsor acceptance or unsupported savings.; label: Boarding and residual specialist; value: Base seat: one operations contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Operate IRIS CRM, reconcile Schedule A residuals, maintain boarding evidence, review Verifi RDR and Ethoca outcomes, and escalate unresolved disputes or reserve changes.; label: ATM field-service specialist; value: Base seat: one service contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Coordinate authorized replenishment, inspect terminals, respond to telemetry alarms, and reconcile service tickets against cash-custodian records without mixing vault cash and revenue.; label: Portfolio operations lead; value: Scaled addition: one full-time operator; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add ownership of daily exception queues, merchant retention, sponsor reporting, and contractor quality when measured workload supports the Scaled six-person operating model.; label: Dispute and support specialist; value: Scaled addition: one specialist contractor; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Add dedicated case handling, evidence collection, and merchant support; the resulting team totals two full-time people and four contractors, not six full-time employees.
